title: Gene Mutations in Secondary Pulmonary Hypertension
brief_summary: As a pulmonary hypertension center, we have created a database that prospectively tracks patients with different forms of secondary pulmonary hypertension. Records include genetic analysis, and clinical and hemodynamic profiles.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of CTEPH and patient consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* No patient consent
